# Creative brief · sample-series / ep01

Fixture data for automated checks. Not a production episode. Do not copy the approval fields.

## One thing

Pick one color and wait for that color.

## Viewer intuition

| # | Viewer’s private objection (their words) | When that is true | Our reply (fact-card B only) | Line ids |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I1 | I arrived first so my color should open now | If the room served arrival order | On average the group waits two minutes less when one color finishes first | L01 |

## Aspect

Landscape 16:9. No vertical cut.

## Duration

Forty seconds is the planning target.

## Model budget

Twenty calls. Stop at 70 percent when a usage file exists.

## Five-beat story

1. Hook: the blue door stayed shut.
2. Break the assumption: arrival order is not the room's order.
3. Mechanism: one color clears before the next.
4. Payoff: the group wait is an average, not this visit.
5. Audience stance: which color do you pick?

## Banned motion

- Every element doing fade + slide-up
- Text that moves while it is being read
